reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A live worker's failed http.invoke/v1 request no longer stays 'uncertain' at its lane head. The run's write tracker stays active and is fenced (CommandSettled) before settle_failed_request reads the write record: unsaved and unpublished requests are re-queued (bounded), saved ones fail with saved_changes, untracked ones fail as 'may have partly applied'. Selected: the new execution-scope and API-worker regressions, durable delivery (updated uncertain expectations), runtime coordination, orphan recovery, chat acceptance and storage report suites; SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: viewers read the same saved answers; the API's wording is a separate change. Process-level worker suites (test_execution_worker.py) were not run locally because children import the primary checkout; the live-worker failure was exercised on a fake scratch Core instead.
